subject: Coord: Executive QBR + product demo — sponsor availability and procurement loop-in
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Holt <dana.holt@finco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Coord: Executive QBR + product demo — sponsor availability and procurement loop-in

Hi Dana — great catching up last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule your Q4 executive QBR with the FinCo senior stakeholders and run a product demo that highlights the throughput/latency profile for your risk-modeling pipelines.

Suggested agenda (30–45m):
- 10m: Executive sponsor remarks / goals for the account
- 15m: Product demo (Rishi + SE deep dive on latency & cost)
- 10m: Procurement/next steps (contracts & timelines)

Can you share 2–3 windows over the next two weeks when Dana (VP Eng) and the procurement rep can join? I'll loop in procurement and your engineering lead for tech alignment.

Attaching a draft agenda and SOC2 summary for your SRE/security team to review. If procurement prefers a separate procurement/contracting slot, we can carve that out immediately after the demo.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: QBR_agenda_v1.pdf
Attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf

From: Dana Holt <dana.holt@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elliot Reyes <elliot.reyes@finco.com>, FinCo Procurement <procurement@finco.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coord: Executive QBR + product demo — sponsor availability and procurement loop-in

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. Dana's calendar is tight but the week of Oct 18 looks promising. Proposed slots: Oct 19 10:00–10:45am PT or Oct 21 2:00–2:45pm PT.

Please include our procurement inbox on the invite (procurement@finco.com). Our security lead (Elliot Reyes) will want to validate the SOC2 summary and confirm redline timelines for any DPA. If you could send the SOC2 top-level artifacts and a short pre-demo checklist for the Eng call, that'll help us prep.

Also: Dana will be traveling Oct 12–15; if we need the VP physically present, avoid that week.

Best,
Dana
VP Engineering, FinCo Capital

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Holt <dana.holt@finco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Elliot Reyes <elliot.reyes@finco.com>, FinCo Procurement <procurement@finco.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coord: Executive QBR + product demo — sponsor availability and procurement loop-in

Thanks — appreciate the windows. Oct 19 10:00am PT works for our team; holding a 45m calendar block for now.

I've attached a short pre-demo checklist for your Engs and the SOC2 summary we referenced. Laura (our Head of Partnerships) will join the QBR to act as sponsor and discuss strategic alignment. Rishi will run the demo and Michael will cover the deep-dive questions on inference profiling.

Pre-demo ask for Elliot / Eng team:
- Confirm the largest model sequence length and average tokens per request
- Share expected concurrent request count for peak windows
- Any redline constraints for data residency / logging retention

I'll send an invite once procurement confirms their attendee for the 19th.

Marissa
Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.md
Attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Reyes <elliot.reyes@finco.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coord: Executive QBR + product demo — sponsor availability and procurement loop-in

Elliot — quick note from the AE/SE side. For the demo we'll focus on three items that map to your priorities:
1) Latency & tail latency for 5k token workloads
2) Cost per 1k tokens across batching/quantization choices
3) Failure handling & graceful degradation during peak bursts

If the Engs can share an anonymized sample trace or a small config snippet (no secrets) ahead of time, Michael can tailor the deep-dive. Would you be open to a 30m technical pre-call the week before (Oct 14 or Oct 15, either 11:00am PT or 3:00pm PT)? That will help us build a demo that maps to your risk-modeling throughput.

-Rishi

From: Dana Holt <dana.holt@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: FinCo Procurement <procurement@finco.com>, Elliot Reyes <elliot.reyes@finco.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coord: Executive QBR + product demo — sponsor availability and procurement loop-in

Marissa — sorry to be the bearer of change, but Dana's travel got extended unexpectedly and she won't be back until Oct 20. Can we move to Oct 21 2:00pm PT instead? Procurement copied here (procurement@finco.com) — can you confirm procurement that this new slot works? Also: procurement would like to see a preliminary contract timeline (target close by Nov 15) and a short statement on data handling (we're sensitive to token retention windows).

Elliot — prepping a small sample trace now; will share via SFTP link after redaction.

Thanks,
Dana

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Holt <dana.holt@finco.com>, FinCo Procurement <procurement@finco.com>, Elliot Reyes <elliot.reyes@finco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coord: Executive QBR + product demo — sponsor availability and procurement loop-in

All — Oct 21 2:00–2:45pm PT confirmed. I've created the calendar invite (link below) and included procurement and security. Agenda updated and attached.

Action items: 
- FinCo (Elliot): please send the redacted sample trace to the SFTP link and confirm whether a pre-demo 30m tech call on Oct 15 11:00am PT still works.
- Procurement: can you confirm who will own contract review and whether Nov 15 close is feasible? If you prefer a separate procurement-only meeting, propose a slot and we'll accommodate.
- Redwood (Rishi/Michael): prepare the tailored demo and a 1-page data handling statement for procurement.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finco-qbr-2026
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/contacts/FINCO-0042

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the QBR.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
